# Pesher Habakkuk Column 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** Final column; well preserved with minor damage at bottom

---

**13:1** "Woe to-him-who causes his-neighbor to-drink,

**13:2** mixing-in his-fury, and-also making-him-drunk,

**13:3** to-gaze on their-festivals!" (Hab 2:15)

**13:4** Its pesher concerns the-Wicked-Priest,

**13:5** who pursued the-Teacher-of-Righteousness

**13:6** to-swallow-him-up in-the-fury-of

**13:7** his-anger, at-his-place-of-exile.

**13:8** And-at-the-time-of the-festival-of-rest, [...]

**13:9** "You-are-filled with-shame instead-of glory.

**13:10** Drink also yourself and-stagger!

**13:11** The-cup-of the-LORD's right-hand

**13:12** will-come-around to-you, and-disgrace upon your-glory" (Hab 2:16).

**13:13** Its pesher concerns the-priest whose-shame

**13:14** surpassed his-glory, because he-did-not circumcise

**13:15** the-foreskin-of his-heart, and-he-walked

**13:16** in-ways-of-excess to-quench his-thirst.

**13:17** But the-cup-of the-wrath-of God will-swallow-him-up, adding-to [...] his-shame, and-the-pain [...]

---
*EMET notes: Column 13 covers Hab 2:15-17, 18-20. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
